title: Network Manager
description:
Network Manager L2/L3 SME & Network Architecture Lead Location: Noida or Gurugram, India
 Shift: Evening/Night Shift (5:30 PM – 2:30AM) Both side Cab facility will be provided 
 Experience Required: 10+ years in networking
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About the Role We are looking for a Network Manager who is both a hands-on L2/L3 Subject Matter Expert (SME) and a proven people leader. You will own network architecture, stability and roadmap for our voice-led KPO/BPO operations, lead the network engineers and IT SWAT team, and remain the final technical escalation point for the toughest issues. You are accountable for outcomes, not only fixes: uptime, voice quality, team capability and client confidence in our network. You will balance deep technical credibility with strong communication and people management. 
 Environment You Will Own Firewall: SonicWall (primary + secondary/HA), dual ISP, IPSec site-to-site VPN to client peer IP Switching: approx. 15 L3/core devices and 100 L2 access switches Wi-Fi: approx. 30 access points Servers: approx. 10 servers Voice: Vonage DID over internet, VDI-based agent desktops Locations: 3 sites (Noida 2, Gurugram) Monitoring: Zabbix, OPManager (distributed, proxy per site) with SNMP, syslog and scripted path monitoring 
 Key Responsibilities Network architecture and strategy Own the end-to-end network architecture across three sites: WAN/ISP design, dual-ISP and SonicWall HA failover, IPSec VPN to client peers, L3 core and L2 access design, Wi-Fi, and the VDI and voice traffic paths. Define and maintain the network roadmap, capacity plan and lifecycle/refresh plan, with business cases and budgets for IT leadership. Lead design reviews for new sites, new client onboarding, client-mandated connectivity and security requirements, and changes to voice infrastructure. Align the network design with global client security, compliance and audit expectations (for example ISO 27001 and client-specific requirements). L2/L3 SME and escalation ownership Be the final technical authority for firewall, switching, VPN, WAN, VDI connectivity and voice-path issues, and decide whether an issue is fixed on the spot or escalated to a vendor or ISP. Lead triage and the incident bridge on major disruptions, isolating LAN, WAN, VPN, firewall, VDI or carrier-side causes while giving clear updates to leadership and client stakeholders. Diagnose complex IPSec VPN problems (Phase 1/Phase 2 failures, IKE negotiation errors, SA lifetime mismatches, DPD misconfiguration) and interpret traceroute/MTR output and firewall and switch logs. Own root cause analysis and problem management for recurring issues, and track permanent fixes to closure instead of repeating quick fixes. Voice quality and resilience Own voice-quality escalations (jitter, packet loss, MOS, one-way audio, call drops) and decide whether the fix is internal (QoS, shaping, configuration) or needs Vonage engagement. Design, tune and validate QoS so voice (RTP/SIP) is prioritised on shared internet links. Validate dual-ISP failover behaviour and confirm the VPN and voice services re-establish cleanly after a failover. Monitoring, reporting and governance Own the Zabbix monitoring strategy: templates, triggers, severity mapping (P1–P4), dependencies and escalation actions, plus VPN tunnel and MTR/path monitoring to the client peer IP and US voice/application endpoints. Own the weekly issue-trend report and client-facing service reviews: recurring root causes, closure status and permanent-fix proposals. Define and enforce incident, change and problem management processes (ITIL), change windows, runbooks, and network DR/BCP documentation. Team leadership Lead, coach and develop the network engineers and the IT SWAT team across shifts: set goals, review performance, plan skills growth, manage rosters and coverage, and build succession. Build runbooks, escalation matrices and training so that one-engineer-per-shift coverage works without depending on a single person. Hire and onboard network talent, and set the standard for technical interviews and capability assessment. Build a blameless culture of root cause analysis and continuous improvement. Vendor and stakeholder management Own the relationships and SLAs with SonicWall, ISPs and Vonage; manage escalations and provide input on renewals and contracts. Communicate with global clients, operations heads and IT leadership, explaining technical issues and trade-offs in business terms. Partner with Operations, Information Security and Infrastructure teams on changes, audits and client requirements. Required Skills and Experience 12+ years in enterprise networking, with deep experience in the KPO/BPO/ITES industry or a similar voice-dependent, client-facing operation. Global experience: has supported or delivered networks for international clients and worked with multi-region stakeholders and teams. Proven network architecture capability: multi-site design with HA, dual-ISP, IPSec VPN and QoS for voice. Expert, credible hands-on L2/L3 knowledge: firewalls (SonicWall strongly preferred), switching, VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, STP and routing. Advanced IPSec VPN troubleshooting, and strong QoS and traffic-shaping knowledge for VoIP; Vonage or similar SIP trunk/DID experience is a plus. Practical experience with network monitoring platforms (Zabbix preferred; OpManager, PRTG, SolarWinds or similar): SNMP, traps, syslog, NetFlow, trigger and alert design. 5+ years of solid people management: building, coaching and rostering a team, handling performance, and growing capability. Excellent communication: confident with senior leadership and clients, calm and clear during incidents, and strong in written RCAs and reports. Working knowledge of ITIL incident, problem and change management, vendor and SLA management, and budgeting. Comfortable making independent decisions during evening/night operations. Preferred Qualifications CCNP or CCIE; SonicWall certification (CSSA/CSNSA or advanced); ITIL Foundation or higher. Prior role as Network Manager or Network Lead in a global BPO/KPO. ISO 27001 awareness and exposure to client audits; exposure to cloud networking (Azure or AWS). Basic Linux and scripting (Bash/Python) for monitoring checks. Key Performance Indicators Reduction in recurring incidents (VDI disconnects, network interruptions, latency) week over week. Mean time to resolve (MTTR) for escalated incidents. Voice quality indicators (jitter, packet loss, MOS) within agreed thresholds. VPN and WAN availability throughout Quality and timeliness of root cause analysis and weekly reporting. Monitoring quality: alert accuracy and low false-positive rate. Team health: shift coverage, runbook coverage, skills development and retention. Client and stakeholder satisfaction in service reviews. What We Are Looking For A network leader who is still technical enough to be the final escalation point, and strong enough with people and stakeholders to run the team and the client conversation. Someone who thinks in architecture and root causes, communicates calmly under pressure, and turns every incident into a stronger network and a more capable team. 
 If interested Kindly share your resume at Muskan.shukla@nlbtech.com

title: Sr IT Engineer
description:
Job Details 
 Job Title: Senior IT Engineer - Virtualization Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure Organization: NEC Corporation of India Ltd. 
 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a System Administrator who will lead the day-to-day administration, optimization, and automation of our enterprise virtualization platforms, datacenter infrastructure, and hybrid cloud environments. The ideal candidate will ensure high availability, security, and disaster readiness of mission-critical workloads, and will support large-scale datacenter projects for government and enterprise customers. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Manage and maintain enterprise virtualization platforms, including VMware vSphere, vCenter, and VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), and Nutanix AHV clusters (Prism Central/Element). Configure and tune vSphere HA, DRS, vMotion, vSAN, and Distributed Switches, and monitor cluster and host health using VMware Aria Operations. Design, implement, and test replication, failover clustering, and disaster recovery solutions (e.g., VMware SRM) for mission-critical workloads. Administer hybrid cloud environments on Google Cloud Platform and AWS, including landing zones, IAM policies, and network architecture. Administer Windows Server and Linux (RedHat, CentOS, Ubuntu, Oracle Linux) environments for performance, security, and uptime. Manage Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, and Group Policy Objects, including user and resource provisioning. Plan and execute patching of servers, ESXi hosts, and workstations using WSUS, ensuring compliance with organizational policies. Execute VM migrations across platforms (VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V, Proxmox VE) using tools such as Nutanix Move. Build and deploy datacenter infrastructure, including server installation, storage and RAID configuration, and OS deployment. Automate routine administration tasks using PowerShell and Ansible, and support application containerization using Docker. Manage the firmware and driver lifecycle for datacenter hardware (e.g., Dell EMC servers). Prepare technical documentation, SOPs, and status reports, and coordinate with customer and internal teams. 
 
 Prerequisites 
 Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering, IT, or a related discipline. Ideal candidate should have a minimum of 3+ years of relevant experience in system administration, virtualization, and datacenter management. Desirable qualities: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification (or equivalent AWS/Azure certification); VMware (VCP) or Nutanix (NCP) certification is an added advantage. Hands-on experience with Hyper-V, Proxmox VE, Docker, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools. Exposure to cybersecurity fundamentals and network traffic analysis. Experience in large-scale datacenter or government/public-sector projects. Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and under pressure. 
 
 Base Location 
 Noida, but flexible to travel (as per project and customer requirements). 
 
 Specialization Description 
 General IT Applications Development includes analysis, programming, and configuration of end user applications and/or systems software including: Analyzing detailed business/functional/technical requirements and specifications for the application Coding internally developed applications and/or configuring commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) applications using programming, scripting, and database languages Supporting application testing, deployment, maintenance, and evolution activities by correcting programming errors, responding to scope changes, and coding application enhancements 
 
 Level Description 
 Entry to developing level professional with little or no prior experience required. Applies a broad theoretical job knowledge typically obtained through advanced education. Work is closely supervised. Works to deliver day-to-day objectives with limited impact on achievement of results for the job area. Explains facts, policies and practices related to job area. Problems faced are not typically difficult or complex.

**EY GDS –Senior Oracle DBA / OCI Administrator Position**
 Over the last decade, cloud adoption and database modernization have become critical enablers for building scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise platforms globally. To support this rapidly evolving and fast paced cloud transformation landscape, we leverage Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) along with industry best practices in database administration, automation, and cloud architecture to deliver reliable, high performance, and cost effective solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As part of our global EY GDS team, you will work on enterprise scale Oracle database and OCI initiatives, supporting mission critical applications across on premises and cloud environments. You will be involved in solving complex technical challenges, driving large scale database migrations, and contributing to the development of next generation cloud and database platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are offering you a demanding role where you will work on mission critical enterprise database platforms and cloud transformation initiatives. You will leverage your expertise in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), database administration, and cloud migration to design, migrate, and manage highly available and secure database solutions. This position includes the opportunity to collaborate with cross functional teams and supporting large scale cloud adoption.

* Database administration, solution design, database migration, and manageability for mission critical enterprise applications across data center and cloud deployments.
* Hands on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including database provisioning, maintenance, and operational support.

* Work with additional database technologies such as MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
* Collaborate closely with Cloud Infrastructure teams to identify and implement efficient, scalable, and secure cloud\-based solutions.
* Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills, effectively collaborating with teams across geographies.
* Flexibility to work independently or as part of a global delivery team to meet project objectives and timelines.
* Support proof of concepts, architectural design sessions, and solution reviews using Oracle Cloud best practices.
* Contribute to automation and optimization initiatives, leveraging DevOps tools where applicable.

* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to create documentation for Proof of Concepts (PoCs).
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a related technology field such as Computer Science, Engineering, MCA, or equivalent.
* 3 to 7 years of relevant experience in architecting, designing, implementing, and/or supporting highly distributed and enterprise\-scale applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience working with at least one public cloud platform such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (preferred) and Azure
* Hands‑on system administration experience on Linux and Solaris platforms.

* Experience presenting solutions to senior leadership and executive audiences, clearly articulating platform and service benefits.
